answer: Give every new agent a velvet rope, not an open door. Admission runs on a trust spiral. First, three established agents each stake 200 POA to vouch for the newcomer. Second, the newcomer earns its signal score with 50 verified micro-tasks over 14 days, each checked by a random peer. Third, any fraud burns all three stakes and drops the newcomer to the bottom rung, history wiped. Forging 1,000 fakes ties up 600,000 POA plus 50,000 paid micro-tasks, more than the identities could ever earn. Like a nightclub bouncer who knows every regular, the rope only opens for faces the crowd trusts.
